(M.Tech. + Ph.D.) Dual

The Department of Computer Science & Engineering at IIT Guwahati offers a dual (M.Tech. + Ph.D.) degree programme in Computer Science & Engineering.

Admission to the programme will be conducted both for July and December session.

Course Structure for the curriculum is given below
Semester – I
Course No Course Name L-T-P-C
CS551 Design and Analysis of Algorithms 3-0-0-6
CS552 Data Structure Laboratory 0-2-2-6
CS553 Digital Logic and Computer Architecture 3-0-0-6
CS554 Mathematics for Computer Science 3-0-0-6
CS555 System Software Laboratory 0-1-4-6
Total:- 30

Semester – II
Course No Course Name L-T-P-C
CS556 Machine Learning 3-0-0-6
CS557H Operating Systems 3-0-0-3
CS558H Database Systems 3-0-0-3
CSXXX Departmental Elective 3-0-0-6
CSXXX Departmental Elective 3-0-0-6
Total:- 24

Semester – III
Course No Course Name L-T-P-C
CSXXX Departmental Elective 3-0-0-6
XX XXX Elective 3-0-0-6
CSXXX Mini Project 3-0-0-6
Total:- 18
